title: Animals & Habitats
subtitle: Spring 1 · 6-week overview
summary: Exploring animals through role play, sounds, songs and dances, encouraging curiosity about animals and natural objects and beginning to recognise and imitate animal sounds.
intentions: To role play animals and explore how they move or sound.
To begin to show curiosity and interest in animals and natural objects.
To listen to animal sounds and begin to recognise and imitate them.
To enjoy animal songs, rhymes and dances.
books: Brown Bear, Brown Bear What Do You See? by Bill Martin, Jr.
The Very Hungry Caterpillar by Eric Carle
songs: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 Once I Caught a Fish Alive

events.label: World Religion Day: Reading our board books on Religion.
National Lego Day: Building using duplo and large lego blocks.
National Puzzle Day: Setting up our inset boards.

days.title: Flower and bug sensory garden
days.what: Set up the messy play tray with fake grass and flowers. Add in some toy insects and encourage the children to explore.

days.title: Animal movements and sounds
days.what: Get out the animal hats and tails from the dressing up resources. Encourage the children to wear them and make the different sounds while walking and moving like the animals.

days.title: Animal feet printing
days.what: Provide some paint, animals and card. Encourage the children to dip the animals into the paint and print with their feet on to the card.

days.title: Marine animals water play
days.what: Set up the water tray with blue water and the marine animals. Allow the children to explore. Talk about the different animals.

days.title: ‘Brown Bear, Brown Bear What Do You See?’ by Bill Martin, Jr.
days.what: Read at circle time with enthusiasm, encouraging the children to name the animals that they recognise.

days.title: Farm animals with shredded paper
days.what: Set up the messy tray with farm animals. Add shredded paper, this will resemble hay. Allow the children to explore. Talk about the different animals and the sounds they make.

days.title: ‘5 Little Ducks’
days.what: Sing with enthusiasm, encouraging the children to count, sing along and copy the actions.

days.title: Colouring animals
days.what: Print off some animal colouring sheets and provide some felt tip pens. Allow the children to mark make.

days.title: Safari small world play
days.what: Set up the safari animals from pre-school and encourage the children to explore. Talk about what animals they can see and their sounds.

days.title: ‘The Very Hungry Caterpillar’ by Eric Carle
days.what: Read at circle time with enthusiasm using the story sack, ensuring that each child is given a prop.

days.title: Green spaghetti jungle
days.what: Cook some spaghetti then add food colouring to turn it green. Put it in the messy play tray and add jungle animals. Allow the children to explore the texture of the spaghetti and the different animals.

days.title: ‘Hop Little Bunnies’
days.what: Play the song ‘Hop Little Bunnies’ and encourage the children to lie down then get up and start jumping, modelling what to do.

days.title: Decorating animal masks
days.what: Buy some plain white animal masks and provide crafting resources. Encourage the children to decorate their masks. Allow the children to wear their masks and make animal sounds and movements.

days.title: Washing animals
days.what: Fill the messy tray with soapy water, sponges and animals. Encourage the children to use the sponges to clean the animals.

days.title: ‘Monkey Puzzle’ by Julia Donaldson
days.what: Read at circle time. Encourage the children to join in e.g. “no, no, no!”
